dialogue.text: The first morning of the new school term -- and Aoi is already running late.
No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: anxious

dialogue.text: Aoi skids around the corner, school bag thumping against her side.
Why did the train have to stall today of all days?!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: angry

dialogue.text: She had already lost ten minutes when the local line stopped between stations.
Now, taking the back streets as a shortcut, she sees a small figure standing by a crosswalk, shoulders shaking.
...Huh?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: confused

dialogue.text: A little boy in a yellow cap is crying, one shoe untied, clutching a crumpled paper tag.
Hey, hey, are you okay?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: neutral

dialogue.text: M-My mom... I can't find her...
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: The light changes. People stream past him without stopping.
Whoa, seriously? Don't move, okay? I'm here.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: determined

dialogue.text: Aoi glances toward the school hill in the distance.
If she runs now, she might still make homeroom.
The boy wipes his face with his sleeve and looks smaller somehow.
...Ah, man. Fine. First day and I'm already doomed.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: anxious

dialogue.text: What's your name?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: determined

dialogue.text: Kota...
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: Okay, Kota. I'm Aoi. We're going to find your mom together.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: determined

dialogue.text: She crouches to retie his shoelace, fingers quick but gentler than her voice.
Did you come from the station? The bakery? Somewhere with lots of people?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: determined

dialogue.text: The flower shop... Mom said wait... then I saw the bus...
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: His words break into hiccuping sobs.
Got it. Flower shop. Come on, hold my sleeve tight.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: determined

dialogue.text: They hurry back a block and a half. Aoi scans every storefront, every face.
Excuse me! Did anyone see a woman looking for a little kid in a yellow cap?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: determined

dialogue.text: At the corner flower shop, a pale woman rushes out the instant she hears them.
Kota!
dialogue.speaker: Mother

dialogue.text: Mom!
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: She drops to her knees and pulls him into her arms so hard his cap falls off.
For a second, Aoi only watches, chest tight from the force of the relief on the woman's face.
Thank you... thank you so much. I only turned away for one minute...
dialogue.speaker: Mother

dialogue.text: It's okay. He stayed near the crossing. He was really trying to be brave.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: smile

dialogue.text: The mother bows again and again, eyes wet. Kota peeks around her shoulder and gives Aoi a tiny wave.
Next time, don't chase buses, okay? They're not that interesting.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: smile

dialogue.text: ...Okay.
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: Aoi checks the time on her phone.
Homeroom started three minutes ago.
Oh, wow. I am absolutely dead.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: embarrassed

dialogue.text: She groans, then laughs despite herself, breathless and bright.
But... yeah. Still worth it.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: smile

dialogue.text: With that, Aoi spins on her heel and tears uphill toward school, later than ever, heart pounding for a completely different reason.
